meta.name: Robert's Rebellion
meta.description: The war to overthrow the Targaryen dynasty, led by a coalition of great houses.

updates.note: Seat of the Mad King, Aerys II Targaryen. Royal fleet and Gold Cloaks are at peak strength.
Traditional seat of the Crown Prince, Rhaegar Targaryen.
Remains a Targaryen holding, but has been a ruin since the great fire of 259 AC.
Seat of Lord Robert Baratheon, a primary leader of the rebellion against the crown.
Held by Lord Jon Connington, a staunch Targaryen loyalist and Hand of the King.
House Tyrell and the Reach remain loyal to the Targaryen crown, committing their massive army to the war.
House Martell is bound to the Targaryen cause by the marriage of Princess Elia Martell to Prince Rhaegar.
House Lannister, under Lord Tywin, remains neutral in the opening stages of the conflict.
